bio.text: Marquette Greene-Scott is the Democratic nominee for Texas's 22nd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, having won the March 2026 Democratic primary, according to the Associated Press as reported by FOX 26 Houston.
According to her campaign website, she is Mayor Pro Tem of Iowa Colony, Texas, where she holds Position 3 on the city council, and practices law in Texas and Louisiana.
Her campaign biography says she was born in Opelousas, Louisiana, moved to Texas in 2010, and spent 14 years teaching high school and college mathematics before becoming an attorney.
She holds bachelor's and master's degrees from Southern University and a law degree from the Paul M. Hebert Law Center, according to her campaign website.
